connector.name: mdedit.ai
connector.registryDescription: Create, read, edit, review, and explicitly publish Markdown Documents in mdedit.ai.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mdedit.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mangoappstudio account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MDEDIT_API_KEY
env.description: Optional scoped mdedit API key. When omitted, the shared mdedit OAuth profile is used.
